findings: MAJOR: the v4 @theme block defined --leading-tight/normal/relaxed, which only override the built-in scale, so leading-hebrew, leading-hebrew-tight and leading-hebrew-relaxed generated NO CSS in v4. Every v4 reader copying Steps 4, 5 and 6 got default line-height on Hebrew text. The v3 branch defined them correctly, so the two branches disagreed.

MAJOR: the space-x-* gotcha was Tailwind v3 era. In v4 space-x-* compiles to margin-inline-start/end and is already direction-aware; the recommended rtl:space-x-reverse sets --tw-space-x-reverse: 1 and moves the spacing to the WRONG side.
